voice.name: Nicolas - French accent & cozy whisper
voice.why: Colin Brisset's own voice (Nicolas, a cozy whisper) for the rumors he passes on: the hush of a man who hears every secret.

colin_cove.text: Somebody fishes the cove on the bay every dusk. A quiet type. He comes back with a full bucket and tells nobody where he goes.

colin_blacklake.text: The north shore of Black Lake has pike, big ones. Few people bother with it, which is why the pike are big.

colin_wholesale.text: The wholesale counter at the dock buys in bulk. If you have crates to sell, do not take less than the market gives.

colin_woodlot.text: The woodlot behind the town has trees marked for cutting. A man with an axe can make an honest day of it.

colin_seedfeed.text: Seed and feed sells everything a farm needs. Ask the clerk what is moving this week. He tells you if you buy something.

colin_range.text: There is a range at the edge of town where people practice. Mind the flags, and mind the neighbors.

colin_clinic.text: The clinic is short of hands, and always has been. If you can stay calm around blood, ask there.

colin_pub.text: The Chotain pub has a back room. Cards on Friday nights, I am told, and the barkeeper keeps that door himself. I only repair watches.

colin_chess.text: Men play chess on the square for small stakes. Sit down, lose gracefully, and they will tell you everything.
